'''Sonata Software Limited''' is an Indian [[information technology]] services company, based in [[Bangalore]]. Sonata provides services in [[business intelligence]] and [[Business analytics|analytics]], [[Software development|application development management]] (ADM), [[Mobile computing|mobility]], [[Cloud computing|cloud]], [[social media]], [[Software testing|testing]], enterprise services ([[Enterprise resource planning|ERP]] and [[Customer relationship management|CRM]]), and [[infrastructure management services]]. The company's shares are publicly traded on the Indian stock exchanges.

== History ==
Founded in 1986 as the computer software division of Indian Organic Chemicals, the company initially made [[Software suite|software package]] products.<ref>{{cite news |title=Indian Organic Chemicals faces cash crunch |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/magazine/economy/story/19890615-indian-organic-chemicals-faces-cash-crunch-816168-1989-06-14 |access-date=13 April 2023 |work=India Today |language=en}}</ref> Sonata Software was spun off as an independent entity in 1994. The company became a [[public company]] and launched its [[initial public offering]] in 1998.<ref>{{cite news |title=Sonata's US venture turns around |url=https://www.rediff.com/computer/1999/jan/21sonata.htm |access-date=13 April 2023 |work=Rediff}}</ref> In 2001, the company obtained SEI-CMMI Level 5 certification and in the following years, set up offices in the US, Europe and Asia Pacific.<ref>{{cite news |title=Sonata Software Achieves SEI CMMI Level 5, the highest standard in Quality Software Delivery |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/announcements/others/article2047952.ece |access-date=May 25, 2011 |publisher=The Hindu Business Line}}</ref>

In March 2014, it opened an American branch in [[Redmond, Washington]].<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|date=2014-03-03|title=IT consultancy Sonata Software expands in Redmond|url=http://www.geekwire.com/2014/consultancy-sonata-software-expands-redmond/|access-date=2016-06-02|website=[[GeekWire]]|language=en-US}}</ref> In August 2014, Sonata Software bought a controlling stake in Rezopia, a travel reservation agency that was the first to use [[Cloud computing|the cloud]] for taking reservations.<ref>{{Cite news | url=https://www.phocuswire.com/Sonata-Software-acquires-majority-stake-in-travel-reservation-platform-Rezopia | title=Sonata Software acquires majority stake in travel reservation platform Rezopia | first=Karthick | last=Prabu | work=Phocuswire | date=August 24, 2014}}</ref><ref name=":3">{{Cite press release | url=https://www.prnewswire.com/in/news-releases/sonata-software-strengthens-travel-vertical-with-acquisition-of-stake-in-travel-saas-rezopia-272533301.html |title=Sonata Software Strengthens Travel Vertical With Acquisition of Stake in Travel SAAS Rezopia | publisher=[[PR Newswire]] | date=August 24, 2014}}</ref> It also acquired Xyka, Rezopia's service provider.<ref name=":3" />

In April 2015, the company entered into a partnership with the [[National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli]] to promote entrepreneurship by providing resources for NIT, Tiruchirappalli's Centre for Entrepreneurship Development and Incubation.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://in.reuters.com/finance/stocks/SOFT.BO/key-developments/article/3194783 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160630150319/http://in.reuters.com/finance/stocks/SOFT.BO/key-developments/article/3194783 |url-status=dead |archive-date=30 June 2016 |title=Sonata Software Ltd and NIT Trichy partner to promote student innovation and entrepreneurship|date=20 April 2015|website=[[Reuters India]]|language=en-IN|access-date=2016-06-02}}</ref> In August 2015, It acquired a 100% stake in Halosys Technologies, which specialized in mobile enterprise.<ref name=":1" /> In October 2015, Sonata Software acquired Interactive Business Information Systems Inc (IBIS), a [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]] based supply chain software company founded in 1989.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/sonata-software-to-acquire-ibis-for-14-mn-115102901326_1.html|title=Sonata Software to acquire IBIS for $14 mn|last=|first=|date=30 October 2015|publisher=[[Business Standard]]|access-date=2016-06-02}}</ref>

In August 2016, Parablu, the US-based provider of CASB-enabled cloud security solutions for Enterprises announced a partnership with Sonata Software.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.dqindia.com/parablu-joins-hands-with-sonata-information-technology-limited|title=Parablu joins hands with Sonata Information Technology Limited|date=2 August 2016|website=dqindia.com|publisher=DQ India|access-date=2016-08-02}}</ref>

In March 2020, Sonata Software announced the signing of a definitive agreement to acquire Melbourne-based Customer Experience company GAPbuster Limited (GBW).<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/software/sonata-software-acquires-australian-company-gbw/articleshow/74475173.cms|title=Sonata Software acquires Australian company GBW|date=2020-03-04|work=The Economic Times|access-date=2020-03-04}}</ref>
